headline: Equity Residential (EQR) On Second Quarter Results And The Case For Undervalued Shares
summary: Equity Residential (EQR) has just released second quarter 2026 results, giving investors fresh detail on how its apartment portfolio is performing. The company also remains in focus following its planned merger into Vivmark Residential. See our latest analysis for Equity Residential. At a share price of US$66.45, Equity Residential has given investors a year to date share price return of 7.13%, while the 1 year total shareholder return is 10.67%, hinting at moderate momentum despite softer...
